## Checklist

- [ ] I kept the change focused and did not include unrelated files.
- [ ] I updated user-facing documentation when behavior, setup, configuration, tools, or output changed.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for the changed behavior, or explained why tests are not applicable.
- [ ] I ran the standard checks, or explained skipped checks below: `python -m pytest -q`, `ruff check main.py pi_agent_bridge tests`, `python -m compileall -q main.py pi_agent_bridge`, `git diff --check`.
- [ ] I preserved task ownership, session privacy, and safe workspace/path boundaries where applicable.
- [ ] I did not include secrets, private data, or unrelated generated artifacts.
